review_method: Independent prospective semantic and control review of the exact source-evidence, event-calendar, and research-plan bytes, including local fingerprint, excerpt-digest, XNYS, chronology, candidate-graph, engine-compatibility, report-contract, executor, and authority checks.

answers.basis: All 30 evidence and calendar IDs match one-to-one. Twenty-eight eligible archived captures precede the same-date XNYS open. The February 11 row is excluded because its official occurrence header is not independently time-bound before open, and the April 3 row is excluded because XNYS was closed.

The five eligible-event counts reconcile to 10, 4, 6, 5, and 3. Context reads are explicit, context-only inputs use null evaluation ranges, evaluation ends at 2026-05-29, and June and V3 remain unavailable.

The plan binds completed reaction bars, prior-session close, joint SPY/QQQ entry and exit timestamps, nth-later bar-open fills, exit at 60+d, and the existing early-close final-bar-open flatten. These rules are compatible with the named engine.
The explicit nine-candidate 3 by 3 grid matches its one-based expansion rule. All 12 undirected immediate-neighbor edges are complete, symmetric, and sorted.

Event P&L, daily fees, concentrations, aggregates, exact neighbor fractions, and seven-field dataset inputs are deterministic. Normal and zero-cost decision traces must match for parent and neighbor runs.

Discovery, walk-forward, stress, delay, and neighbor gates are fixed before execution. Scenario-positive folds are defined consistently, stage barriers prevent partial adaptation, and every all-gate survivor freezes simultaneously up to the predeclared cap of two.

The four-worker spawned executor, one-claim workers, stage barriers, leases, heartbeats, three-attempt cap, retry classification, create-only publication, short SQLite transactions, and terminal failure classes match the existing restart-safe infrastructure.

The artifacts grant no strategy execution, controlled evaluation, holdout, PAPER, broker-write, or live authority. Implementation must merge separately and receive an exact merged-main launch review before the first reservation.

scope_limit: The review revalidated the local artifacts, hashes, temporal metadata, XNYS mapping, source-excerpt digests, plan semantics, and repository compatibility. It did not re-fetch Internet Archive or BLS pages and did not open .trading-lab, market bars, runtime databases, reports, metrics, partial strategy results, protected data, PAPER state, or broker state.
